limitations: Only singleton-seeded synchronous probabilistic zero forcing on unweighted K_{2,b}, b>=3. No claim on all K_{a,b}, unique CDF crossing, expectation-optimality, or the earliest late reversal time. Historical-priority risk remains.
scientific_integrity: The two-round comparison is proved with exact formulas, analytic central-binomial bounds and checked finite cases; the eventual-tail comparison is an all-parameter finite-chain proof. No independence or external certification is claimed.
title: Two-round and tail-order reversal for probabilistic zero forcing on \(K_{2,b}\)
